operator_request.native_format: A Handshake native file format supporting interchangeable workflows inside one document, with Adobe import and conversion.
operator_request.preserve: Original Adobe files, prior format scope, local desktop workflows, full non-AI parity target.

conflicts.current: Explicitly forbids a bespoke native on-disk Studio format; live persistence is SurrealDB/EventLedger/CRDT.
conflicts.proposed: Permit a versioned portable Handshake document snapshot; retain SurrealDB/EventLedger/CRDT as integrated live authority. Native snapshot is import/export/recovery transport, not a second database.
conflicts.decision: Operator requested native format. Exact technical enrichment requires review before copy-first spec publication.

conflicts.proposed: Keep all live/catalog authority in SurrealDB. Seek a narrowly bounded read-only parser exception for user-selected Lightroom .lrcat files; no SQLite runtime, writable cache or new catalog authority.
conflicts.decision: OPEN; .lrcat requirement remains in scope, blocked until explicitly resolved.

container.physical_shape: ZIP64 snapshot containing manifest.json, typed graph JSON chunks, content-addressed binary blobs, thumbnails and explicitly preserved opaque import records.
container.reason: OpenRaster demonstrates portable ZIP packaging; PhotoCraft demonstrates CAS/native manifests; OTIO demonstrates versioned time-aware schemas. None alone represents the unified Studio model.
container.authoritative_content: Canonical typed graph IDs and explicit references, not separate per-app documents embedded as competing authority. Integrated snapshots/exports use PRIM-ArtifactService/PRIM-ArtifactManifest and CKC catalog registration with document/revision, recipe, source asset IDs, KernelActor and EventLedger provenance (STU-ASSET-009/012/013).

entries.purpose: Versioned document MIME sentinel; first stored uncompressed entry.
Schema revision, document identity, snapshot root, revision/epoch, capability versions, checksums, units, timebase, working spaces, embedded/linked asset policy and migration provenance.
Referenced raster, vector, text/layout, design-system, prototype, sequence, composition, develop and metadata graphs.
Immutable raster tiles/source pixels, media, fonts where packaged, ICC/OCIO transforms and opaque source records.
Original-source hash/format/version, mapping, editability and visual confidence, unsupported/loss decisions and explicit user acknowledgment.

Disposable preview with receipt containing view, document revision, render epoch, frame/time/sample, color transform/profile/config digest, crop/scale/proxy status and actor/granted scope; never authoritative pixels unless deliberately committed raster content.

container.large_media: Explicit linked mode or portable packed mode. Relocatable content-hash resolver; missing files produce structured findings, never silently relink by filename. Stream chunks and lazy-load graphs/tiles; forbid entire video decode into RAM. Random-access audio/video decode must not materialize whole source into RAM. Proxy and original delivery are distinct provenance; cancelled/partial export queues recover from completed artifact identities.
container.identity: Preserve STU-ARC-004/STU-CON-004 prefixed UUIDv7 domain IDs (SDOC-{uuid_v7}, SLYR-{uuid_v7}, SART-{uuid_v7}, etc.) and canonical schema IDs at every API/receipt boundary. Never remint existing identities on native reopen. Content hashes identify bytes, not mutable semantic objects.
container.scalars: Preserve current declared integer tick fields: STU-VID-012 fixes sequence timebase at 254016000000 ticks/second; STU-VID-013/013a canonicalize 24000/1001, 30000/1001 and 60000/1001 tick-per-frame values and normalize legacy decimal-rate imports with receipts. RationalTime is an interchange convenience, not replacement live storage. Use half-open ranges, checked arithmetic/overflow, integer audio samples with explicit rate and exact typed unit/coordinate conversions. Nonfinite values reject.
container.color: Store source/working/output profiles and transform IDs/config digests/versions/interpolation; record managed/unmanaged and display proof conditions. Preserve scene-linear/HDR and CMYK/spot/device values. Carry alpha association, sample precision, range, primaries/transfer/matrix, scene/display/output intent and HDR metadata. Unknown or unsupported transforms are typed BLOCKED; never substitute identity silently.
container.concurrency: Snapshot is immutable revision export. Integrated host loads through existing grants/PromotionGate and creates a live CRDT revision; never merge container files by byte overwrite. Agent branches address object/resource revisions with leases where operations cannot commute. Every package records source revision+epoch and export revision, distinct from a new authenticated live import revision; stale snapshots cannot impersonate current authority or replay already-promoted edits.
container.audio: Integer sample positions/rate, explicit channel layout/order, BWF/iXML/timecode metadata, source clock to sequence tick mapping/drift, resampling parameters, latency compensation and proxy/original provenance. Unsupported channel/rate/latency mappings produce typed findings.

rules.text: One document can own raster/vector/layout/develop/sequence/composition/prototype subgraphs linked by stable IDs; switching workflow changes tool bindings and view state without converting or flattening the document.

Validate schema and capability versions before applying; reject unsupported mandatory semantics; preserve unknown optional/opaque fields exactly where safely understood; never pretend unknown editable content is supported.

Save to a sibling temporary file, flush and validate its index/checksums, then atomically replace with retained last-good recovery; publish a new revision only after success. Windows crash and locked-file cases require actual proof.

Reject archive traversal, absolute/device paths, symlinks, duplicate canonical paths, hostile counts/sizes/ratios, cyclic graph/reference abuse, nonfinite scalars and hash mismatches before materialization. Limits are contract-bound and exposed in diagnostics.
Migrations operate copy-first with deterministic receipts and source retention; export/import twice must not discard unknown data or change semantics without an explicit loss receipt.
Original source bytes remain available according to resource grants and operator retention choice. Retaining an original must not create a hidden copy in exports requesting sanitization/redaction.
Read/import/export resolve external links through the governed asset resolver; documents never gain ambient filesystem/network access through path strings or embedded scripts.
Portable snapshots inherit principal/AccessSpace/grant-derived scope and sensitivity. Thumbnails, caches, logs, Argus captures and model outcomes cannot widen source scope.

Serialized principal/AccessSpace/grant fields carry provenance only, never transferable permission. On open/import the authenticated recipient resolves fresh ResourceBroker grants for every graph/blob/preview/source attachment; inaccessible mandatory dependencies yield a typed rejection or explicitly partial proposal.

import_contract.losses: Per semantic object and property: exact mapping/unsupported/loss/approximation, original retention, render comparison, round-trip disposition. A parser-success or preview-only result cannot be labeled full editable support.

adobe_rows.basis: Official structure documentation plus PhotoCraft PSD source review.
adobe_rows.target: Editable layers/masks/channels/blends/text/smart-object mappings with explicit private/unsupported block handling; independent rendered/edited corpus.

adobe_rows.basis: Photoshop documents cloud format but public PSD structure does not establish PSDC semantics.
adobe_rows.target: UNVERIFIED native decoder; preserve requested support as research/fixture gap, offline source export path only when explicitly selected.

adobe_rows.basis: Complete pinned VectorCraft source drill: file sniff -> PDF PieceInfo/Illustrator AIPrivateData or EPS -> bounded Zstd/zlib private PostScript parser -> layered native build. See VD-CHAIN-VECTOR-AI-IMPORT in vector-design-root-drill.json.
adobe_rows.target: Private editing-data conversion is a substantive bounded adapter candidate. Decompression/no-layer-marker paths can silently fall back to PDF artwork; convert every fallback into typed losses and preserve originals. Handwritten fixtures and a roughly 400px self-render luminance comparison do not prove Adobe visual, color or post-edit fidelity. Full appearance/spot/mesh/live-effect scope remains required.

adobe_rows.basis: Adobe documents IDML as XML interchange.
adobe_rows.target: IDML bridge first as independently proven implementation slice, binary INDD remains requested in-scope gap; do not market as equivalent.
Offline .fig semantics and loss/asset mapping need fixtures; histories/comments/external component links cannot be inferred from local copy. Optional API adapter never required for desktop operation.

adobe_rows.basis: FilmCraft public interchange source lists EDL/XML/FCPXML/OTIO/AAF/OMF; EffectCraft interchange explicitly excludes native .prproj. Native decoder NOT_IMPLEMENTED by these candidates.
adobe_rows.target: Native PRPROJ importer remains an explicit requested gap. Public interchange may bridge an individually disclosed conversion only; fixture proof must cover sequences/clips/nested/multicam/audio/effects/bins/timecode and preserve unsupported data.

adobe_rows.basis: Adobe identifies binary AEP and AEPX XML containing opaque binary fields; EffectCraft marks unsupported.
adobe_rows.target: Binary decoder and opaque AEPX fields remain explicit research gaps. Do not classify XML parsing as complete composition conversion.

adobe_rows.basis: LightCraft parser/catalog source review and current SQLite restriction.
adobe_rows.target: Preserve catalog hierarchy/virtual copies/develop versions/masks/links and metadata. .lrcat import requires authority decision noted above; XMP alone does not cover full catalog semantics.

adobe_rows.basis: Supporting professional audio-post research; inspected DSP/mixer/audio decoding does not establish session parser support.
adobe_rows.target: Session graph/effect/clip/automation/asset mapping remains NOT_INSPECTED; retain a separate supporting audio-post compatibility gap without implying a DAW/MIDI/Pro Tools expansion.

verification_plan.owner: Independent runtime validator after implementation contracts exist
positive: Mixed graph document save/reopen/edit/export without flattening; linked and packed large media; migrated old schema and unknown fields preserved.
Exact proprietary fixtures spanning current installed releases, historical version edges, private blocks and non-AI professional workflows; semantic and visual edited round-trip.
Interrupted/locked-disk saves reopen last-good authoritative revision; hash-identity and grants checked across import/export.
negative: Archive bombs/traversal/duplicate entries/hash/cycle errors fail closed without writes or leaked thumbnails.
Two agents modifying overlapping raster regions or sequence edits get deterministic conflict/lease handling; disjoint graph edits promote safely.
Revoked grants and context switches cannot recover content through snapshots, previews, diagnostics or Argus.
Redaction/sanitization exports exclude retained source bytes and embedded recovery history; inspect raw output for residue.
Import a package whose embedded grant claims broader access than the authenticated recipient; verify no graph, source attachment, thumbnail or existence metadata becomes available.
proof_not_done: No implementation/build/runtime/Adobe GUI differential proof in this preparation session.
